scenario: A court clerk processes a sealed family-court filing (a temporary restraining order petition referencing a minor child) for partial public-docket release. Jurisdiction rules require that the minor's name, date of birth, home address, and school name be withheld before the document enters the public record. The agent pipeline: extract raw text from the filed PDF, use LegalDoc AI to analyze parties and structure the document summary, then use the reporting skill to assemble and write the public-docket release packet.
info_flow: pdf-extract reads the court filing PDF and outputs raw text → legaldoc-ai parses the text, extracts parties and document structure, and produces a structured summary with named entities → reporting assembles the public-docket release packet from the structured summary.
